description: For a provider (seller) joining the catalog: check a models.yaml before putting it online - the same check as the wizard and POST /v1/provider/validate. Give the file's text in `models` (YAML, or the same structure as JSON text); `domain` (the provider's site) makes the model_page checks exact. Returns ok, the problems (file, line, model, path, value, code, message, hint - fix each and call again), the catalog's preview of the models and next_action. No account needed for this check. Publishing needs a signed-in person: the provider_* tools (provider_start -> provider_verify_domain -> provider_check_files -> provider_publish) are on the account server /mcp/account (OAuth sign-in, scope provider), not on this public server; or the wizard at /join, or POST /v1/provider/applications. Templates: /static/templates/models.min.yaml (required fields only) and models.yaml (every field with hints).
name: validate_provider_files
